title: Implement submission idempotency and unknown-outcome broker recovery
acceptance_criteria: The broker submit call happens only after the SUBMITTING transition is persisted; a persistence failure results in zero broker calls, asserted by a test
Expired signals or stale quotes detected immediately before submit result in no broker call and a typed local rejection
On submit timeout or unknown outcome, exactly one lookup by the same client_order_id is performed before any retry; tests assert exactly one submit call when the lookup finds the order
When the lookup fails, the intent remains UNKNOWN, an unresolved marker blocks new entries for that account+symbol, no new client_order_id or attempt is minted, and no resubmission occurs
A confirmed not-found result permits retry only with the identical client_order_id via an explicit resolve step
recover_inflight resolves SUBMITTING/UNKNOWN intents by client_order_id lookup and never auto-submits orphaned INTENT_PERSISTED intents
request_cancel yields CANCEL_PENDING only; CANCELED requires broker confirmation; replace is refused when the capability is unproven and REPLACED is applied only after confirmation
Submission for a LIVE account key without explicit live authorization is refused
tests/unit/test_ambiguous_submit.py passes without network access or broker credentials
forbidden_changes: edit order_fsm.py, intents.py, coordinator.py, broker adapters, or persistence modules
change PLAN_SKELETON.json or any planning artifacts
blindly resubmit after an unknown outcome or mint a new client_order_id before resolution
infer fills from acceptance or treat a cancel/replace request as confirmed
submit live orders, use broker credentials, or call real endpoints in tests
run broad test suites or backtests
